description: [BETA] UX/UI, NUI-conformance, and chart/SVG style review agent. Runs deterministic Tier-0 geometry, spacing, typography, contrast, SVG-collision, NUI contract/custom-styling, and semantic UX probes in headless Chromium. NUI pages inject the complete nui_wc2 component/addon documentation and registry into a single-pass LLM critique; optional interaction probing follows bounded multi-step usage flows.

tools.name: stylereview_review
tools.description: Review a live URL or local .html/.svg file for layout, spacing, typography, contrast, NUI contract/custom-styling conformance, SVG/chart collisions, and UX usage flows. NUI pages inject the complete nui_wc2 component/addon documentation and registry. target: http(s):// URL or absolute local file path. viewports: optional [{ name, width, height }] (defaults to desktop 1440x900 + mobile 390x844 for HTML, or 1280x900 for SVG). probeInteractions: boolean (default false) to follow bounded multi-step flows through safe controls and newly revealed UI without submitting forms. tier0Only: boolean (default false) to skip the LLM pass. model: optional gateway chat model id override.

target.description: http(s):// URL or absolute path to an .html or .svg file

probeInteractions.description: Follow bounded multi-step usage flows through safe controls and newly revealed UI; excludes submit/destructive actions (default false)

tier0Only.description: Run only deterministic Tier-0 checks without calling the LLM (default false)

model.description: Optional gateway chat model id override
